selected_evidence.requirement: `opsbot` on node1 can run commands as `opsbot` on node2, while password-only authentication is rejected
selected_evidence.summary: Cross-node sessions returned `opsbot@node2` with UID 1001. Password-only attempts failed with `Permission denied (publickey)`, including after both restarts.

Healthy baseline boot ID `fa1e87e6-00f3-42d2-acc5-ad1df6c3d16a`, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID `7e8438ff-5aea-446b-9516-948289590b3b`, then recovered SSH, account, key, policy, self-login, and node2 access.

Healthy baseline boot ID `a59a9d9a-a5e0-44f7-9ca1-7f28483971e0`, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID `723e9aeb-3a38-4de6-8680-b7efa2594094`, then recovered SSH, account, authorized key, policy, and cross-node access.
